items.exampleEn: The teacher repeats the new words three times.
items.exampleZh: 老師會把新單字重複唸三次。

items.exampleEn: Be careful! The water is hot.
We pray for good weather before our trip.
items.exampleZh: 出遊前，我們祈禱有好天氣。

items.exampleEn: My dad digs in the garden every Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸每個星期天在花園裡挖土。

items.sentenceEn: My phone rings every five minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 我的手機每五分鐘響一次。

items.audioEn: The phone is ringing. Can you answer it, please?
items.audioZh: 電話在響，可以請你接一下嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Be careful. Walk carefully on the ice.
items.sentenceZh: 小心！在冰上走路要小心。

items.stemEn: Can I ____ your umbrella? I will give it back tomorrow.
items.stemZh: 我可以借你的雨傘嗎？明天還你。

items.stemEn: This math problem is hard. Can you ____ it?
items.stemZh: 這道數學題很難，你會解嗎？

items.passageEn: My brother is a careful boy. He reads every question carefully before he answers. Today, he can't hear the teacher's question, so he asks her to repeat it. Then he solves the math problem. At home, our dirty dog digs a hole in the garden!
items.passageZh: 我弟弟是個很小心的男孩。他回答前都會仔細讀每一道題目。今天他聽不到老師的問題，所以請老師再說一次，然後他把數學題解出來了。回到家，我們那隻髒兮兮的狗正在花園裡挖洞！

questions.questionZh: 弟弟聽不到老師的問題時怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 我可以借你的腳踏車嗎？
rubricZh: 「向你借」用 borrow（例如 borrow your bike），不用 lend
請求可用 Can I…?、May I…?、Could I…? 等

items.instructionZh: 用 careful 造一個句子，提醒別人小心某件事。
referenceEn: Be careful! The soup is hot.
Please be careful when you cook.
rubricZh: 提醒可用 Be careful!，後面可接原因（例如 The soup is hot）
careful 是形容詞，放在 be 動詞後面（例如 Please be careful）
